evidence.title: Leicester going back into lockdown has nothing to do with 5G – Full ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact rated as false the claim that Leicester is going back into lockdown soon after 5G was rolled out there, stating 5G is not linked to Covid-19 cases.
evidence.rating_text: 5G coverage was available in Leicester by November 2019, months before Covid-19 was detected in the UK. 5G is not linked to cases of Covid-19. Leicester had some lockdown restrictions re-imposed because the number of cases there was increasing.
